about_the_game:
Try the demo of our magical typing game!

Step into a world of potions, spells, and fast fingers. In this demo, you’ll experience the core gameplay: brewing potions by typing words, racing against the clock, and dealing with spoiled mixtures.

🎯 Your goal? Brew the largest number of potions before time runs out.

Just play the demo, stay logged into Steam, and your score will automatically be added to the online leaderboard. Try to be in the Top-10. Get ready – the potions won’t brew themselves!

  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with OpenGL 3.3 support
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
